notes.title: Our Love Will Grow 2 on Greenlight
notes.content:
Hi guys,

Our Love Will Grow 2 is now on greenlight.

After reading through feedback that was given by people we decided to add gender choices and make the story play a bigger part in the sequel. We've added a bigger plot, scenes with various characters, more events and a story that will unfold as you play through the game.

We also reduced most of the cave material collecting/grinding to focus more on unlocking new places to explore.

Thanks for all the feedback so far. You can check out the sequel on greenlight here.

http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=641424330
